request.model: ref types.ResourceRef, period Period, options pagination.Options
request.validation: source required fields/types/date formats; exact email v1 resource UUID and service/generation/scope/endpoint; no implicit project adoption; protected values reveal only in explicit typed wire encoding

response.mapping: generated nested DTOs, exact integers, optional pointers; credentials/DKIM keys/domains/user text/message identifiers/reasons protected; source IDs and project validated; untrusted ref ignored; unknown extensions protected
response.identity: source-owned ID scanned before decoding credential fields for create/update/rotate/transfer; caller refs retained on errors; transfer target project is explicit response metadata, receipt/ref retain originating scope, never infer target adoption
response.limits: shared response byte bound plus MaxItems for statistics/delivery/stop-list arrays (config default for zero); ResponseLimit retains typed prefix and aggregate counters; collections use common cursor bounds, typed envelopes omit duplicate rows

errors.mapping: shared sanitized HTTP status mapping; provider messages/descriptions protected, not diagnostics; 500 mutation outcome unknown, no replay; source SMTP rate prose does not establish undocumented management rejection statuses

receipt: all mutation paths finalize not_sent/accepted/rejected/unknown and preserve independently trustworthy exact refs; receipt is not goal completion; no mutation replay or target/name adoption
observation: exact resource status active/blocked/error/deleted; unknown/missing remains unknown, delete absence only exact GET NotFound; receipt goals filtered by originating capability. Rotation/transfer/domain/stop-list outcomes cannot be inferred from active resource state.

pagination.contract: common pagination.Options scope/operation/revision/filter-bound cursors, bounded rows/pages; preserve typed provider envelopes without duplicate data; only strictly advancing source offsets followed; absent/zero/nonprogress has no proven terminal rule and never declares Complete
limitations: Unconfirmed pagination terminal rule: next_offset/cursor_next has no documented end sentinel. Strictly advancing offsets are supported, incomplete rows retained; zero/absent/nonprogress never claims completion.
